heading.en: Alma preaches in private—He sets forth the covenant of baptism and baptizes at the waters of Mormon—He organizes the Church of Christ and ordains priests—They support themselves and teach the people—Alma and his people flee from King Noah into the wilderness. About 147–145 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua tala'i atu faalilolilo Alema—Ua faatu mai e ia le feagaiga o le papatisoga ma faia papatisoga i vai o Mamona—Ua faatulaga e ia le Ekalesia a Keriso ma faauu faitaulaga—Ua latou faalagolago ia i latou lava ma a'oa'o le nuu—Ua sosola Alema ma ona tagata i le vao mai le Tupu o Noa. E tusa o le 147–145 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now, it came to pass that Alma, who had fled from the servants of king Noah, repented of his sins and iniquities, and went about privately among the people, and began to teach the words of Abinadi—
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, sa oo ina salamo Alema, o lē na sola mai auauna a le tupu o Noa, i ana agasala ma ana amioletonu, ma sa alu atu faalilolilo o ia i totonu o le nuu, ma amata ona ia a’oa’o atu upu a Apinati—

verses.en: Yea, concerning that which was to come, and also concerning the resurrection of the dead, and the redemption of the people, which was to be brought to pass through the power, and sufferings, and death of Christ, and his resurrection and ascension into heaven.
verses.sm: Ioe, e uiga i mea o le a oo mai, ma e uiga foi i le toetutu mai o e ua oti, ma le togiolaina o tagata, lea o le a faataunuuina e ala i le mana, ma mafatiaga, ma le maliu o Keriso, ma lona toetu mai ma lona afio a’e i le lagi.

verses.en: And as many as would hear his word he did teach. And he taught them privately, that it might not come to the knowledge of the king. And many did believe his words.
verses.sm: Ma o le toatele o e sa fia faalogo i ana upu sa a’oa’o atu e ia. Ma sa ia a’oa’o atu faaliloliloi latou, ina ia le iloa e le tupu. Ma e toatele sa talitonu i ana upu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that as many as did believe him did go forth to a place which was called Mormon, having received its name from the king, being in the borders of the land having been infested, by times or at seasons, by wild beasts.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo o le toatele o i latou o e sa talitonu ia te ia sa o atu i se nofoaga sa ta’ua o Mamona, na maua lona igoa mai le tupu, ma sa i tuaoi o le laueleele na lofia, i ni vaitaimi po o vaitau, e manu ’aivao.

verses.en: Now, there was in Mormon a fountain of pure water, and Alma resorted thither, there being near the water a thicket of small trees, where he did hide himself in the daytime from the searches of the king.
verses.sm: O lenei, sa i ai i Mamona se puna o vai manino, ma o iina sa alu atu i ai Alema, ona sa i ai iina lata ane i le vai se vaovao o laau laiti, sa lafi ai o ia lava i le ao mai sailiga a le tupu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that as many as believed him went thither to hear his words.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina o atu iina le toatele o i latou sa talitonu ia te ia e faalogologo i ana upu.

verses.en: And it came to pass after many days there were a goodly number gathered together at the place of Mormon, to hear the words of Alma. Yea, all were gathered together that believed on his word, to hear him. And he did teach them, and did preach unto them repentance, and redemption, and faith on the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua mavae ni aso e tele sa toatele se vaega o tagata sa faapotopoto atu i le nofoaga lea o Mamona, e faalogologo i upu a Alema. Ioe, sa faapotopoto faatasi i latou uma o e na talitonu i ana upu, e faalogologo ia te ia. Ma sa ia a’oa’o atu i latou, ma tala’i atu ia te i latou le salamo, ma le togiola, ma le faatuatua i le Alii.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he said unto them: Behold, here are the waters of Mormon (for thus were they called) and now, as ye are desirous to come into the fold of God, and to be called his people, and are willing to bear one another’s burdens, that they may be light;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fai atu o ia ia te i latou: Faauta, o vai nei o Mamona (ona sa faapea ona ta’ua o ia vai) ma o lenei, ona ua outou manana’o e o mai i le saogalemu o le Atua, ma ta’ua o ona tagata, ma outou loto e fefaasoaa’i ona tauave o a outou avega, ina ia māmā ai;

verses.en: Yea, and are willing to mourn with those that mourn; yea, and comfort those that stand in need of comfort, and to stand as witnesses of God at all times and in all things, and in all places that ye may be in, even until death, that ye may be redeemed of God, and be numbered with those of the first resurrection, that ye may have eternal life—
verses.sm: Ioe, ma outou loto e faanoanoa faatasi ma e e faanoanoa; ioe, ma faamafanafana atu ia te i latou o e e manaomia le faamafanafanaga, ma tutulai o ni molimau a le Atua i taimi uma ma i mea uma, ma i nofoaga uma tou te i ai, seia oo lava i le oti, ina ia mafai ona togiolaina outou e le Atua, ma faitauina faatasi ma i latou o le ulua’i toetutu, ina ia mafai ona outou maua le ola e faavavau—

verses.en: Now I say unto you, if this be the desire of your hearts, what have you against being baptized in the name of the Lord, as a witness before him that ye have entered into a covenant with him, that ye will serve him and keep his commandments, that he may pour out his Spirit more abundantly upon you?
verses.sm: O lenei ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai o le manao lea o o outou loto, se a se mea tou te tetee ai i le papatisoina i le suafa o le Alii, o se molimau i ona luma ua outou ulu atu i se feagaiga faatasi ma ia, o le a outou auauna atu ia te ia ma tausi ana poloaiga, ina ia mafai ona ia liligi atili ifo lona Agaga i luga ia te outou?

w.en: which is the be the desire

verses.en: And now when the people had heard these words, they clapped their hands for joy, and exclaimed: This is the desire of our hearts.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ina ua faalogo mai tagata i nei upu, sa patipati o latou lima i le olioli, ma alalaga mai: O le manao lea o o matou loto.

w.en: which is the This is the desire

verses.en: And now it came to pass that Alma took Helam, he being one of the first, and went and stood forth in the water, and cried, saying: O Lord, pour out thy Spirit upon thy servant, that he may do this work with holiness of heart.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina ave e Alema o Helama, o ia lea o se tasi o tagata muamua, ma ua alu atu ma ua tu i totonu o le vai, ma alaga, e faapea: Le Alii e, liligi mai lou Agaga i luga o lau auauna, ina ia mafai ona faia e ia lenei galuega ma le paia o le loto.

verses.en: And when he had said these words, the Spirit of the Lord was upon him, and he said: Helam, I baptize thee, having authority from the Almighty God, as a testimony that ye have entered into a covenant to serve him until you are dead as to the mortal body; and may the Spirit of the Lord be poured out upon you; and may he grant unto you eternal life, through the redemption of Christ, whom he has prepared from the foundation of the world.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona fai atu e ia o nei upu, sa oo mai i luga o ia le Agaga o le Alii, ma sa fai atu o ia: Helama e, ona ua tuuina mai ia te a’u le pule mai le Atua Malosi Aoao, ou te papatiso atu ia te oe o se molimau ua e ulu atu i se feagaiga e auauna atu ia te ia seia oo ina e oti e tusa ai ma le tino faaletino; ma ia liligi mai le Agaga o le Alii i ou luga; ma ia tuuina mai e ia ia te oe le ola e faavavau, e ala i le togiola a Keriso, o lē na saunia e ia mai le faavaega o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And after Alma had said these words, both Alma and Helam were buried in the water; and they arose and came forth out of the water rejoicing, being filled with the Spirit.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona fai atu e Alema o nei upu, sa tanumia uma Alema ma Helama i le vai; ma sa la’ua tutula’i a’e ma o mai i fafo o le vai ma le olioli, ua faatumulia i le Agaga.

verses.en: And again, Alma took another, and went forth a second time into the water, and baptized him according to the first, only he did not bury himself again in the water.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe ave e Alema se tasi tagata, ma toe alu atu faalua i totonu o le vai, ma papatiso ia te ia e pei o lē na muamua, ae sa lē toe tanumia e ia o ia lava i le vai.

verses.en: And after this manner he did baptize every one that went forth to the place of Mormon; and they were in number about two hundred and four souls; yea, and they were baptized in the waters of Mormon, and were filled with the grace of God.
verses.sm: Ma o le ala lenei sa papatiso ai e ia i latou uma taitoatasi o e na o atu i le nofoaga o Mamona; ma o lo latou aofai pe tusa ma le lua selau ma le fa agaga; ioe, ma sa papatisoina i latou i vai o Mamona, ma sa faatumulia i latou i le alofa tunoa o le Atua.

verses.en: And they were called the church of God, or the church of Christ, from that time forward. And it came to pass that whosoever was baptized by the power and authority of God was added to his church.
verses.sm: Ma sa ta’ua i latou o le ekalesia a le Atua, po o le ekalesia a Keriso, mai lena taimi. Ma sa oo ina o soo se tasi sa papatisoina i le mana ma le pule a le Atua sa faaopoopo i lana ekalesia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Alma, having authority from God, ordained priests; even one priest to every fifty of their number did he ordain to preach unto them, and to teach them concerning the things pertaining to the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faauu e Alema ia faitaulaga, ona sa ia te ia le pule mai le Atua; sa faauu e ia faitaulaga e taitoatasi i le taitoalimagafulu o i latou, e tala’i atu ia te i latou, ma a’oa’o atu i latou e uiga i mea e faatatau i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: And he commanded them that they should teach nothing save it were the things which he had taught, and which had been spoken by the mouth of the holy prophets.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia poloaiina i latou ia latou lē a’oa’o atu se mea, vagana ai mea na ia a’oa’o atu, ma mea na fetalai mai i fofoga o perofeta paia.

verses.en: Yea, even he commanded them that they should preach nothing save it were repentance and faith on the Lord, who had redeemed his people.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa ia poloaiina lava i latou ia latou lē a’oa’o atu se mea, vagana ai le salamo ma le faatuatua i le Alii, o lē ua togiolaina lona nuu.

verses.en: And he commanded them that there should be no contention one with another, but that they should look forward with one eye, having one faith and one baptism, having their hearts knit together in unity and in love one towards another.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia poloaiina i latou e lē tatau ona i ai se finauga o le tasi ma le isi, ae e tatau ona latou taga’i i luma ma le manatu e tasi, i le faatuatua e tasi ma le papatisoga e tasi, ua fili faatasi o latou loto i le lotogatasi ma le alofa o le tasi i le isi.

w.en: that ought not so to be

verses.en: And thus he commanded them to preach. And thus they became the children of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ia poloaiina o i latou e tala’i atu. Ma sa faapea ona avea ai i latou ma fanau a le Atua.

verses.en: And he commanded them that they should observe the sabbath day, and keep it holy, and also every day they should give thanks to the Lord their God.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia poloaiina i latou ia latou tausi le aso sapati, ma tausi lona paia, ma ia latou avatu foi i aso uma le faafetai i le Alii lo latou Atua.

verses.en: And he also commanded them that the priests whom he had ordained should labor with their own hands for their support.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia poloaiina foi i latou e tatau i faitaulaga o e na ia faauuina ona galulue malolosi i o latou lava lima mo lo latou lava tausiga.

verses.en: And there was one day in every week that was set apart that they should gather themselves together to teach the people, and to worship the Lord their God, and also, as often as it was in their power, to assemble themselves together.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai se aso e tasi i vaiaso taitasi sa tuu ese faapitoa latou te potopoto faatasi ai e a’oa’o atu tagata, ma tapua’i atu i le Alii lo latou Atua, ma o lenei foi, i soo se taimi latou te mafai ai, ona latou faapotopoto faatasi i latou lava.

verses.en: And the priests were not to depend upon the people for their support; but for their labor they were to receive the grace of God, that they might wax strong in the Spirit, having the knowledge of God, that they might teach with power and authority from God.
verses.sm: Ma o faitaulaga, ia aua ne’i faalagolago i le nuu mo le tausiga o i latou; ae ia latou maua le alofa tunoa o le Atua mo a latou galuega, ina ia mafai ona latou tutupu malolosi i le Agaga, i lo latou maua o le malamalama o le Atua, ina ia mafai ona latou a’oa’o atu ma le mana ma le pule mai le Atua.

verses.en: And again Alma commanded that the people of the church should impart of their substance, every one according to that which he had; if he have more abundantly he should impart more abundantly; and of him that had but little, but little should be required; and to him that had not should be given.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe poloaiina e Alema e tatau i tagata o le ekalesia ona faasoa atu a latou mea, ia taitasi le tagata e tusa ma mea ua maua e ia; afai e tele mea ua maua e ia, e tatau ia te ia ona faasoa tele atu; ma o ia o lē ua itiiti mea ua i ai, ia itiiti mea e manaomia mai ia te ia; ma o ia o lē ua leai ni mea, e tatau ona foa’i atu i ai.

verses.en: And thus they should impart of their substance of their own free will and good desires towards God, and to those priests that stood in need, yea, and to every needy, naked soul.
verses.sm: Ma sa tatau ona faapea ona latou faasoa atu o a latou mea i o latou lava loto malilie ma naunauga lelei i le Atua, ma ia i latou o faitaulaga o e e manaomia le fesoasoani, ioe, ma i agaga taitasi uma ua manaomia le fesoasoani, ma ua lē lavalava.

verses.en: And this he said unto them, having been commanded of God; and they did walk uprightly before God, imparting to one another both temporally and spiritually according to their needs and their wants.
verses.sm: Ma o mea ia sa fai atu ai o ia ia te i latou, ona sa poloaiina ai o ia e le Atua; ma sa latou savavali sa’o i luma o le Atua, ma faasoa atu le tasi i le isi faaletino ma faaleagaga e tusa ma mea sa latou manaomia ma o latou manaoga.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that all this was done in Mormon, yea, by the waters of Mormon, in the forest that was near the waters of Mormon; yea, the place of Mormon, the waters of Mormon, the forest of Mormon, how beautiful are they to the eyes of them who there came to the knowledge of their Redeemer; yea, and how blessed are they, for they shall sing to his praise forever.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo o nei mea uma sa faia i Mamona, ioe, i tafatafa o vai o Mamona, i totonu o le vao sa lata ane i vai o Mamona; ioe, o le nofoaga o Mamona, o vai o Mamona, o le vao o Mamona, sa matuā matagofie i latou i le vaai a i latou o e na o atu i le malamalama o lo latou Togiola iina; ioe, ma amuia lava i latou, ona o le a latou pepese i lona viiga e faavavau.

verses.en: And these things were done in the borders of the land, that they might not come to the knowledge of the king.
verses.sm: Ma o nei mea sa faia i tuaoi o le laueleele, ina ia le iloa i latou e le tupu.

verses.en: But behold, it came to pass that the king, having discovered a movement among the people, sent his servants to watch them. Therefore on the day that they were assembling themselves together to hear the word of the Lord they were discovered unto the king.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa oo ina ua iloa e le tupu se fegasoloa’iga i totonu o le nuu, sa auina atu e ia ana auauna e vaavaai i latou. O lea i le aso na latou faapotopoto faatasi ai i latou lava e faalogologo i le afioga a le Alii na maua ai i latou ma faailoa atu ai i latou i le tupu.

verses.en: And now the king said that Alma was stirring up the people to rebellion against him; therefore he sent his army to destroy them.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina fai mai le tupu ua faavevesi e Alema le nuu ia fouvale e faasaga ia te ia; o lea na auina atu ai e ia lana autau e faaumatia i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Alma and the people of the Lord were apprised of the coming of the king’s army; therefore they took their tents and their families and departed into the wilderness.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina logo Alema ma tagata o le Alii e uiga i le o mai o le autau a le tupu; o lea sa latou ave ai o latou faleie ma o latou aiga ma o ese atu i le vao.

verses.en: And they were in number about four hundred and fifty souls.
verses.sm: Ma o lo latou faitau aofai e tusa ma le fa selau ma le limagafulu agaga.
